Package gui

Class LoginController

java.lang.Object
gui.LoginController
public class LoginController extends Object
Controller for the Login screen of the BistroNine application. This controller handles both Remote mode (standard login) and Terminal mode (guest/subscriber login). It manages user authentication, identification via barcode scanning, and navigation to dashboards.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Standard JavaFX initialization method.

    • setClient

      public void setClient(ClientController client)
      Sets the client reference for communication with the server. Also updates the static login controller reference in ClientController.
      Parameters:
      client - The ClientController instance to use.

    • setMode

      public void setMode(LoginController.Mode mode)
      Configures the UI mode (Remote or Terminal).
      Parameters:
      mode - The desired Mode.

    • updateUI

      private void updateUI()
      Adjusts visibility and properties of UI elements based on the current mode. TERMINAL mode hides the sidebar and guest button, and enables tag scanning. REMOTE mode shows the full layout for standard user login.

    • handleScanTag

      void handleScanTag(ActionEvent event)
      Handles the scan tag button click. Simulates a barcode scan and sends an identification request to the server.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggering this method.

    • onIdentificationResponse

      public void onIdentificationResponse(Object response)
      Callback for when the server responds to an identification request (by tag).
      Parameters:
      response - The response from the server, expected to be a Subscriber object.

    • getLoginBtn

      void getLoginBtn(ActionEvent event)
      Handles the standard login button click. Validates inputs and sends credentials to the server.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggering this method.

    • handleServerLoginResponse

      public void handleServerLoginResponse(data.Subscriber subscriber)
      Processes the login response from the server. If successful, redirects the user based on the current mode.
      Parameters:
      subscriber - The Subscriber object if login was successful, null otherwise.

    • enterTerminalMenu

      private void enterTerminalMenu(data.Subscriber subscriber)
      Transition logic for Terminal mode after a successful login. Sets global session data and closes the login modal.
      Parameters:
      subscriber - The logged-in Subscriber.

    • openDashboard

      private void openDashboard(data.Subscriber user)
      Transition logic for Remote mode after a successful login. Loads the User Dashboard and sets the scene.
      Parameters:
      user - The logged-in Subscriber.

    • getBackBtn

      event - The ActionEvent triggering this method.
